changes.name: StarterEggSystemFixed
changes.source:
local egg=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("StarterEgg"):WaitForChild("Egg")
local prompt=egg:WaitForChild("HatchPrompt")
local pets={
 {name="Cloud Bunny",chance=60,color=Color3.fromRGB(235,245,255)},
 {name="Sky Fox",chance=30,color=Color3.fromRGB(100,205,255)},
 {name="Sun Cub",chance=9,color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,70)},
 {name="Storm Dragon",chance=1,color=Color3.fromRGB(150,95,255)}
}
local function roll()
 local r=math.random(1,100);local total=0
 for _,p in ipairs(pets) do total+=p.chance;if r<=total then return p end end
 return pets[1]
end
local function spawnPet(player,pet)
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end
 local old=workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name.."_EquippedPet");if old then old:Destroy() end
 local part=Instance.new("Part");part.Name=player.Name.."_EquippedPet";part.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball;part.Size=Vector3.new(3.5,3.5,3.5);part.Color=pet.color;part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;part.CanCollide=false;part.Massless=true;part.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.new(4,1,3);part.Parent=workspace
 local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui");gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,40);gui.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.8,0);gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.Parent=part
 local label=Instance.new("TextLabel");label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);label.BackgroundTransparency=1;label.Text=pet.name;label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.25;label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;label.TextScaled=true;label.Parent=gui
 local rootAtt=Instance.new("Attachment");rootAtt.Name="PetFollowPoint";rootAtt.Position=Vector3.new(4,1,3);rootAtt.Parent=root
 local petAtt=Instance.new("Attachment");petAtt.Parent=part
 local align=Instance.new("AlignPosition");align.Attachment0=petAtt;align.Attachment1=rootAtt;align.MaxForce=50000;align.Responsiveness=12;align.RigidityEnabled=false;align.Parent=part
end
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 if not coins or coins.Value<10 then return end
 coins.Value-=10
 local pet=roll()
 local inv=player:FindFirstChild("Pets");if not inv then inv=Instance.new("Folder");inv.Name="Pets";inv.Parent=player end
 local owned=Instance.new("StringValue");owned.Name=pet.name;owned.Value=pet.name;owned.Parent=inv
 spawnPet(player,pet)
 prompt.ObjectText="HATCHED: "..pet.name
 task.delay(2,function() if prompt.Parent then prompt.ObjectText="STARTER EGG" end end)
end)
